game.name: Sonic Unleashed (Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Sonic Unleashed for Xbox 360 brings the famous blue hedgehog to life in a new kind of adventure. Mixing 3D and 2D, the title pits you against Dr Robotnik who has scattered the pieces of the world. It's up to you to find the pieces of the emerald of chaos and put it back together. The software manages the day/night cycle, which influences Sonic's behaviour.
